messages:
netops-bot: [ALERT] High packet loss detected on upstream 'BackboneX' from dublin-eu (DUB). Loss ~28% across transit pair; p95 latency spike. Automated detection triggered at 2026-11-02T11:21:28Z.

lena: ugh saw this alert, confirming from our end. investigating BGP adjacencies to BackboneX.

sre-oncall: I'm paged, will take lead. @lena can you post quick traceroute + bgp summary? I'll open incident channel.

lena: paste: ```
# traceroute to 34.210.55.3
 1  10.2.1.1  0.34 ms
 2  100.64.1.10  1.2 ms
 3  * * *
 4  192.0.2.45  12.6 ms  13.1 ms  12.7 ms
 5  198.51.100.1  *  *  *
```

lena: bgp summary for peer BackboneX: ```
Peer: 198.51.100.1 ASN 64512
  State: Established
  Prefixes: 24
  In/Out updates last 5m: 14/20
  Flaps: 7 in 10m
```

sre-oncall: Thanks. Looks like transit is flapping and some prefixes dropping. Impact: multiple customers in eu-west region reporting timeouts. @support-lead can you start collecting customer reports and map to impacted prefixes?

support-lead: Will do. Initial customer ticket: #5678 (real-time analytics) reports 503s across eu-west; setting severity P1 and notifying account team. Will update ops status page.

omar: I see increased packet loss from our ddos sensors toward BackboneX egress. Could be upstream congestion or misconfigured BFD. Reaching out to BackboneX NOC.

netops-bot: @sre-oncall Incident channel created: #incident-1849998888. Severity: sev2 -> escalated to sev1 based on customer-impact flags. Pager escalation sent to on-call manager.

maya: FYI we have a canary route via AlternateCarrier (AS64513) from DUB. Can we advertise more-specifics to shift traffic?

eng-platform: We can push target-only prepends/communities to prefer alternate upstream for affected prefixes, but we need a coordinated change window + rollback plan.

sre-oncall: Do it. Plan: 1) coordinate with BackboneX to get status 2) announce temporary community to prefer AlternateCarrier for impacted prefixes 3) monitor for 15m then decide on more aggressive failover. @omar please confirm BFD/links.

omar: Contacted BackboneX NOC: ticket BX-9123 opened. They report a partial fiber fault and are rerouting internally; ETA unknown. BFD sessions showing flap every ~30s.

lena: Applying export-community to impacted prefixes to prefer AS64513 now. Command snippet: ```
set policy export pref-alternate carriers {
  match prefix-list impacted-eu
  set community 64513:100 additive
}
commit
```

eng-platform: Change applied and propagated. Confirming route propagation to providers.

netops-bot: Change recorded by deploy-bot at 2026-11-02T11:30:12Z. Rollback window set to 20m.

sre-oncall: Monitoring. Can we get latency/packet-loss graphs for the affected prefixes? @lena @omar

lena: Pushing graphs to incident doc: loss dropped from 28% -> 4% after prefer-alt announcement. Latency p95 improved from 650ms -> 120ms.

support-lead: Customer updates: 2 larger customers still report intermittent errors but majority restored. Posting interim status: "Routing mitigation in progress; partial restoration observed; investigating upstream provider outage".

omar: BFD flaps continue on primary, but alternate is stable. BackboneX says they are continuing repairs; will keep ticket open.

sre-oncall: Good. We'll keep prefer-alt in place until BackboneX confirms stable. @eng-platform please schedule automated rollback after 2h if no further issues.

eng-platform: Ack — scheduled rollback job at 13:30Z unless we set 'extend' flag.

netops-bot: paging: @oncall-manager - incident escalated to P1 due to customer impact (2 enterprise customers).

oncall-manager (not in participants): joining soon.

lena: Quick note: DNS for some customers (low TTL) ended up routing to the affected prefixes; we've reached out to CS to advise keep TTL low until fully green.

support-lead: CS told customers with persistent errors to retry after 5 min and to open support if they still see failures; collecting logs for RCA.

sre-oncall: After 45m monitoring, incident moving to mitigated state but still tracking until upstream confirms. Next steps: 1) Confirm BackboneX repair 2) Rollback pref discipline when stable 3) Draft postmortem with timeline + customer impact map. Assigning postmortem to lena + support-lead.

lena: Assigning initial timeline notes in the doc. Root-cause hypothesis: partial fiber cut + aggressive internal reroute at BackboneX causing transient BGP flaps and packet loss; combined with our local BFD sensitivity causing withdraws.

omar: FYI I adjusted BFD timers on the DUB-facing session to be slightly more tolerant (tx=300ms, rx=300ms, mult=3) to reduce noise. Will include config change in the RCA.

support-lead: Customers updated at 12:15Z; one enterprise requested phone bridge which we provided. No data loss reported, only request failures/timeouts.

netops-bot: Incident state changed to MONITORING at 2026-11-02T12:06:10Z.

sre-oncall: Handoff plan: I'll be primary until 13:00Z, then @lena will take watch for the afternoon; if BackboneX still degraded at rollback job time, we'll延长 (extend) and coordinate.

lena: taking 13:00Z watch. Will confirm any final rollback before 13:30Z.

eng-platform: rollback executed at 13:31Z (scheduled job). Verified routes reverted; monitoring shows steady-state and no return of packet loss.

netops-bot: Incident resolved at 2026-11-02T13:35:30Z by eng-platform. Summary: temporary routing preference to AlternateCarrier mitigated customer impact while BackboneX performed repair.

sre-oncall: Closing notes: Severity downgraded; postmortem assigned. Thanks everyone for quick coord.

support-lead: Filing customer impact summary and tickets to billing team for potential SLA credits.

lena: Will draft technical RCA and include traceroutes, bgp logs, and config diffs. Expected PM posted in 48h.

maya: Adding note: we should add automated detection to try alternate upstream earlier (runbook suggestion).

sre-oncall: Agreed — add to runbook and Redwood Optimize checklist.

netops-bot: Thread archived for incident-1849998888.
